decision.analysis: Round 1 with no prior validation results. Based on the cross-cutting research, the strategy is: (1) establish a tiny_cnn baseline to confirm learnability, (2) test residual_cnn as the primary CNN contender with hidden capped at 96 per schema constraint, and (3) test compact_transformer as the top-priority architecture leveraging convolutional tokenization for 28x28 pathology images. All three use per-channel standardization (mandatory given channel std 0.12-0.18), AdamW with conservative weight decay, cosine scheduler, and mild label smoothing for the 1.63x imbalance. Augmentations are limited to hflip and rotate180 to preserve tissue-orientation cues. Learning rates are set on a log scale: 3e-4 for CNNs, 1e-4 for the transformer (smaller token count requires more stable optimization).

candidates.rationale: Primary transformer candidate. Conv tokenizer with patch_size=4 yields 7x7=49 tokens at dim 192, preserving local histological texture. 3 attention layers with 6 heads (192/6=32 per head) model global tissue context. mlp_ratio=4 gives FFN dim 768. Layer norm pre-norm, GELU, dropout 0.1. AdamW wd=1e-4, cosine LR from 1e-4. Label smoothing 0.05 addresses mild imbalance. Conservative augmentation (hflip, rotate180) preserves orientation cues. Expected ~2-3M params, well within 90K-sample budget.

Primary CNN contender. 4 residual blocks with hidden=96 (schema cap for residual_cnn), 3x3 stride-1 convolutions, batch norm, global average pooling. ~1.5M params. Dropout 0.2 for regularization. AdamW wd=1e-4, cosine LR from 3e-4 (higher than transformer due to simpler architecture). Label smoothing 0.05. Conservative augmentation. Expected to be a strong, low-variance baseline that the compact_transformer must beat.

Lower-bound baseline. 3 conv blocks, hidden=64, ~0.5M params. Higher LR (1e-3) and larger batch (256) for fast convergence of the small model. Dropout 0.3 and label smoothing 0.1 for stronger regularization given limited capacity. Serves as the learnability check and calibrates the marginal gain of deeper/attention-based models. Conservative augmentation (hflip, rotate180).

fallback.analysis: Deterministic diverse candidate set; selection uses validation accuracy and macro-F1, never test metrics.
